|rulings=* Read this as owner's move phase and ''any'' exterior sites (not as owner's move phase and ''owner's'' exterior sites).<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Imperial%20Arrest%20Order%20%26%20%E2%80%A2Secret%20Plans</ref>
* For Nabrun and Elis, the origin site and the destination site must ''both'' be exterior (interior/exterior sites such as [[Death Star]]: [[Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]] are allowed).
* Light has the option to decline and cancel the retrieval.
* The amount of Force used ('X') equals the retrieval amount initiated, even if the Lost pile has fewer than X cards.
* If Light is to search their Lost Pile to retrieve card(s) that meet specific criteria, Light searches first, then pays for [[Secret Plans (Dark){{!}}Secret Plans]] only if they find valid card(s) and choose to retrieve.
